strategies.name: Gap and Go
strategies.plain: When the market gaps and the first minutes agree, trade with the gap.

strategies.name: Pivot Point Reversion
strategies.plain: Fade the first touch of yesterday's pivot resistance or support levels.

strategies.name: First-Hour Reversal
strategies.plain: After a big first hour, bet the rest of the day goes the other way.

strategies.name: Time-of-Day Hold
strategies.source: Heston, Korajczyk & Sadka (2010); practitioner closing ramp
strategies.plain: Own the market only during one fixed part of every day.

strategies.name: Volume Spike Fade
strategies.plain: When one minute has a huge burst of volume and a sharp move, bet it snaps back.

strategies.name: Crabel Stretch Breakout
strategies.source: Toby Crabel, Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and ORB (1990)
strategies.plain: Trade the first move from the open bigger than the market's usual opening 'stretch'.

strategies.name: Midday Range Breakout
strategies.plain: Trade the afternoon break out of the quiet lunchtime range.
